decision_scope: Source-qualified supplied-model planning reference; no native adapter approval

identity.maintenance: Named author, beta metadata and selected revision; no support promise or complete release-history claim.

reason: Retain explicit model/belief/planner separation while requiring concrete belief, progress, clock, arity and horizon repairs and native qualification.
target_and_uncertainty: Finite or explicitly scoped supplied-model expected reward under declared belief/history/horizon; approximate search values are separate from latent identification and learned-policy confidence.
conversion_contract: Bind supplied model revision, initial/current belief, history, state/action/observation IDs and decision clock.
Reject zero/nonfinite belief mass and undeclared lost support; distinguish weighted/unweighted measures, deprivation and approximation transforms.
Preserve primitive/option reward and duration conventions, horizon and black-box arity; ensure progress and an outer execution deadline.
Record native build, random sources, action order, simulation budget and completed counters; library/CLI/MCP retain target, refusals and uncertainty limits.

alternatives.reason: Broader uninspected models, source defects and native build/rights exceed this profile.
Can preserve explicit model semantics after reviewed fixes and finite-oracle native tests.
No demonstrated benefit warrants duplicating belief/search/stochastic-state and maintenance contracts.
Separately tests intended target and numerical recurrence.

alternatives.route: Hidden-state identification or optimal-value confidence engine
alternatives.reason: Supplied-model planning does not establish those scientific guarantees.

costs_to_measure: Search and memory by accuracy target

owner_obligations.scientific: Latent observation/intervention meaning and model/selected-policy uncertainty
owner_obligations.maintainer: Pinned native environment, repair and conformance
owner_obligations.operator: Actual rights, budgets, deadlines and recovery

revisit_trigger: Complete source/compiler/dependency custody plus reviewed source-contract repairs and registered native evidence; changed model, target or clocks require new review.
limitations: Thirteen selected immutable sources and independently authored finite examples only; no upstream code executed.
Supplied-model planning is not hidden-state identification, calibrated policy-value inference, measured bank economics or native product acceptance.
Complete release/compiler/ABI/dependency custody, transitive rights, broader models and native qualification remain open.
